response.answer: You had opposed the festival contract because its format apparently allowed long, unbroken rehearsal blocks that trigger your shoulder impingement. Your physio log ties flares to such blocks, and your orthopedist recommends no more than 90 unbroken minutes. Although the festival is prestigious and pays well, you considered those benefits beside the point. The visible record also says the festival restored standard union breaks and that your objection was then gone, so it does not support why you passed on it again after that change.
